question: Q1: on fresh seeds, do JO-on (sighted G1/FLIP) flies roll over after a 20 deg nose-down tilt more often than OFF?
Q2: with the JO input frozen at its last pre-tilt encoder output, do they still roll over (paired by type and seed)?

sources.reused: jo_zone_crossing.Trial/run_arm (REPRO unchanged), antennal_gravity_live (complete, encoder, zone_rates), jo_command_yoke.outcome, coxa_offset_yoke.reproduces, coxa_push_response (create_session, force_ok)

context: Step D trial unchanged (push-response N context, A_ON assisted posture, hair plates, 20 admitted coordinates); 20,000 physics steps, 4,000 neural ticks; gravity G0 through state 5005, R_y(-20 deg) G0 from 5006

arms.order: REPRO, then per seed OFF, G1, G1F, FLIP, FLIPF

freeze_rule: FROZEN arms: each JO encode while tilt_event is None is delivered and stored; every later encode delivers the stored output (rates and recorded d); delivery (Poisson forced spikes) unchanged

measure.fall: jo_command_yoke.outcome: body tilt vs recorded gravity >= 45 deg at any stored state after 5005; t_fall_ms and peak tilt reported; censored at run end

Q1.test: one-sided Fisher exact, pooled sighted (G1+FLIP, 24) vs OFF (12), sighted greater
rules: JO_FALLS_NOT_REPLICATED if sighted fraction <= OFF fraction

Q2.test: paired by type+seed, pooled G1+FLIP (24 pairs); b = sighted falls only, c = frozen falls only; exact one-sided binomial at 0.5
rules_first_match: RESPONSE_NEEDED if b > c and p(b) <= 0.05
RESPONSE_PROTECTIVE if c > b and p(c) <= 0.05

reported_not_labelled: post-tilt JO d (held and live) and rates

integrity.Z2: per seed: common RNG uniforms, schedule and initial qpos; frozen = sighted partner exactly: qpos and commands through state 5005, fired/JO delivery/rates on every pre-tilt tick; first qpos difference after 5005
integrity.Z3: freeze audit: frozen pre-tilt ticks = encoder, never held; every post-tilt tick held at the last pre-tilt rates and d; same pre-tilt tick count as partner; sighted rates = encoder at every tick, never held
integrity.Z4: gravity G0 then R_y(-20) G0 from 5006; tilt/event records; no applied wrench (force_ok)
integrity.Z5: OFF withheld at every tick; others deliver only to JO sets; d5_type/jo_frozen recorded
integrity.Z6: hard gate: REPRO equals the Step D archive exactly (coxa_offset_yoke.reproduces plus JO delivery), archive sha checked
integrity.Z7: source lf-sha256 values equal this protocol; per-arm cns_seed; distinct tick-1 uniforms across seeds

expectations.E3: FLIPF falls < FLIP falls and G1F falls >= G1 falls

declared_interpretation.RESPONSE_NEEDED: falls need the JO input to follow the tilt
declared_interpretation.RESPONSE_NOT_NEEDED: falls do not need the JO to sense the tilt; instability belongs to the JO-on operating state
declared_interpretation.RESPONSE_PROTECTIVE: JO tilt response helps keep the fly up; needs replication before any balance claim

interpretation_limits: One tilt (20 deg nose-down step) in one context (Step D, assisted posture).
Modelled JO transduction (Step B encoder) and Step D zone assignments.
12 seeds per condition; binary fall at 45 deg, censored at run end.
FROZEN holds the rate, not the spike train; it is a probe, not physiology.
Q1 does not control for pre-tilt state differences between JO types and OFF.
Closed loop: post-tilt differences compound; divergence is an outcome.
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: run once; no retry, resume or exclusion
